svg.title: Step 7 mockup 24: The hall screen around the tournament: loud key moments, and an index of twenty views
svg.text: 24 · The hall screen around the tournament: loud, celebratory key moments
Use case: the screen tells the story all evening. Six key moments drawn as full 1920×1080 frames (shown at one third), then the twenty views as an index. Demo names only.
3 · Race to the final, with the cut line
Slide-in: the 1st headline from the left, then the avatars; the standings
strip slides in from the right, ▲▼ count up. Glow behind 1st, confetti
Glow pulse and ring ripple on the avatar; "+2" counts up from 0; stars pop
in one by one; confetti. Game art behind.
Bars grow from the left; the cut line draws across; the next-needed callout
pulses once. Names slide ▲▼ when points change.
Avatar glow and pulse; the headline types in; badges pop in with a small
The card slides in from the right with a glow; the points count up; one card
Everything dims, then CHAMPION slams in with a glow and shake; crown drops;
confetti falls; finalists 2–4 are cheered at the sides.
Holds about 20 s, then the photos.
Index · the twenty views and the widgets behind them (small tiles; the six moments above are the loud ones)
★ = drawn above as a full frame. Every view uses the game art as its background when a game is on; times are held by Moments, not by the widget.
